verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is an agent framework, not solely an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The pack only documents MCP client capability: the agent connecting to other MCP servers. That is the separate client-side story and earns no credit here. No first-party MCP server or 'serve as MCP' mode appears in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
